{"file":"src/Features/Cdn/Providers/SelfHosted/ObjectKeyStore.php","line":80,"rule":"Nullable, union, or false-returning APIs whose failure value reaches code that assumes a usable value","severity":"high","message":"get_attached_file() returns string|false, and hash_file() also returns false when the path is false or the file is missing or unreadable (with a warning). The method is declared `: string` under strict_types, so a missing attachment or file throws a TypeError instead of giving callers a handled failure. Check the path and file readability up front, and return a nullable string or throw a specific exception for the drift check."}
